Instead, the agent abandoned this specific plan due to the lack of an API key and invented a method using 'predefined driving distances.' This deviation from the specific verification instructions prevented the identification of real-world data, causing the subsequent steps to operate on fictional/mock data rather than verifying the actual task requirements.
